name: Marek Ironheart
summary: At the Farstrider Lodge, Marek Ironheart tests those who seek the respect of its hunters. The veteran dwarven hunter is stationed in south-eastern Loch Modan and keeps to the traditions of the wild.

sections.title: Master of the Hunt
sections.body: At the Farstrider Lodge, Marek Ironheart expects hunters to prove their skill. The lodge overlooks the lake from a ridge in south-eastern Loch Modan and gathers marksmen and trackers from across the dwarven lands. Marek pays little heed to titles or boasts. Anyone seeking the lodge’s respect must show practical skill against the beasts roaming Loch Modan, with the patience and nerve of a true hunter.

faq.answer: Marek Ironheart is a dwarven huntsman at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan. He tests visitors who seek acceptance among the lodge’s trackers and outdoorsmen.

faq.q: Where can I find Marek Ironheart?
faq.answer: Marek Ironheart is at the Farstrider Lodge, in the hills along Loch Modan’s south-eastern shore.

faq.q: What kind of tasks does Marek offer?
faq.answer: Marek sends hunters to track and cull local wildlife around the loch, testing their survival skills against dangerous crocolisks.

faq.q: Is Marek related to any other known dwarves?
faq.answer: Marek Ironheart may be kin to Archaeologist Adamant Ironheart and Imme Ironheart, who share his notable dwarven surname. Marek devotes his life to hunting rather than excavating relics.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can see Marek Ironheart’s rugged Farstrider Lodge traditions in his challenges, which test your accuracy and tracking against local wildlife.
As a dwarf, you can see in Marek the outdoorsman culture cherished by many Khaz Modan dwarves. He chooses the quiet watch of the mountains over Ironforge’s forge fires.
